_meta.description: Hand-computed expected values for the governed metrics on examples/retail-demo/data/demo.db, grouped by the 'region' dimension. Anchors the facade money test (ticket #5, spec S8.3). Regenerate only with an independent computation; never from seed/SQL logic.
rules_applied: Exclude orders with status CANCELLED or RETURNED.
Pre-2024 EMEA rows are stored in local currency without conversion: multiply amount and product_cost by currency_conversion_rate.rate_to_usd for the row's currency. All other rows are already USD.
